WPSS No. 2313 of 2019 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Gaurav Singh, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. P.C. Bisht, Standing Counsel for 
the State. 
Learned counsel for the State prays 
for and is granted four weeks’ time to file 
counter affidavit. 
List thereafter. 
No good ground is made out to grant 
interim relief to the petitioner at this stage. 
Stay application CLMA No. 13648 of 2019 
stands disposed of.
